name: satyalens-synthetic-dev-messages

label_definitions.suspicious: Template written to exhibit a financial social-engineering pattern.
label_definitions.legitimate: Template written to resemble routine, benign communication.

intended_use: Development, demonstration and functional/integration testing ONLY.
separation: Not a Protocol v5 source; never a donated genuine alert (source SYN_DEV, never DONATION); not part of any training pool, frozen test set, exclusion log or sealed manifest.
limitations: Synthetic, template-generated text written by the project author; narrow, author-biased style.
Does NOT represent the distribution of Indian financial alerts or of real scam traffic.
Labels reflect template intent, not verified real-world outcomes.
Metrics on this data are synthetic-only and must not be used to claim real-world performance or to select a model against the frozen test set.
Edge-case 'expected_text_classifier_status' values depend on the model vocabulary.
licence: Created for this project; no third-party data (repository licence, MIT per pyproject.toml).
